content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Driver (for Double Decker Bus) post is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation or 10th standard and possess a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) license to be eligible for the Driver position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the ICSIL Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Driver (for Double Decker Bus) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Driver position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Driver (for Double Decker Bus) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 32918/- plus EPF.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Driver post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Driver (for Double Decker Bus) in this ICSIL recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ICSIL Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 590/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, Skill Test, Document Verification, and Interaction/Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job offered is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The specific venue details will be available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the official website or the notification PDF for the exact location.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, HMV license, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.
